runs-since-20261012.sql: SELECT r.*, c.commit AS cfg_commit FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run_id,commit FROM run_config QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id ORDER BY off)=1) c USING(run_id) WHERE r.character='SILENT' AND r.ascension=10 AND r.finished AND r.started >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-12 00:00:00' ORDER BY r.started,r.run_id

run_config.sql: SELECT * FROM run_config WHERE character='SILENT' AND ascension=10 ORDER BY off

fights.sql: SELECT * FROM fights WHERE character='SILENT' AND ascension=10 AND first_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-12 00:00:00' ORDER BY run_id,fight_no

floors.sql: SELECT * FROM floors WHERE ascension=10 AND first_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-12 00:00:00' ORDER BY run_id,floor

sl_attempts.sql: SELECT * FROM sl_attempts WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-12 00:00:00' ORDER BY run_id,ts,off
